Metadata.title: jadero.dev
Metadata.description: Personal site and portfolio of a software engineer.

backend.title: Backend architecture
backend.line: A modular monolith plus a few services, with hexagonal modules where there are real rules.

reliability.title: Reliability and messaging
reliability.line: Events leave through an outbox, consumers are idempotent and failed messages end up in dead-letter queues.

testing.title: Testing and quality
testing.line: A test pyramid with contract tests, real databases in containers and coverage gates in CI.

cicd.title: CI/CD and infrastructure
cicd.line: A pipeline and a changelog per service, Docker, nginx and backups that are tested by restoring them.

security.title: Security
security.line: Admin login, OWASP controls on the AI features and a human approval step before an agent can change anything.

delivery.title: Product delivery
delivery.line: A fast, accessible site in three languages, and El Refugio in production with real users.

ai.title: Applied AI
ai.line: Retrieval, guards and evals behind an agent that answers questions about my work.

process.title: Engineering process
process.line: A decision record for each design choice, work tracked in the open and coding agents that work under review.
